quotes.text: For Marketing API, the rate limit is applied to the ad account across the same Business Use Case.
The quota depends on the app's Marketing API Access Tier.
When you exceed this limit, spread your requests more evenly over time rather than sending them in bursts.
You are in the standard tier of Marketing API access if you have Full access of the Marketing API Access Tier feature.
The Marketing API Access Tier controls your rate limits, Business Manager access, and system user capacity.
